title: Oven Roasted American Beef Burger
description: A classic American style beef burger, oven roasted to perfection. This recipe yields a juicy and flavorful burger that's perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Roasted American Cheese (such as cheddar or American)

instructions: Season beef patties with salt and pepper.
Place beef patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Place oven roasted burger buns on a separate baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the burger is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the oven roasted burger buns in the oven for 2-3 minutes.

Assemble the burgers by spreading mayonnaise or spread of choice on the bottom bun, followed by a beef patty, a slice of roasted American cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and finally the top bun.
